caption: Flowchart of eligibility criteria and the invited cohort of childhood cancer survivors for the HEAR study. From the Swiss Childhood Cancer Registry, survivors diagnosed per ICCC-3 or with Langerhans cell histiocytosis, aged ≥18 and treated with chemotherapy and/or head, neck or spine radiation give 2750 eligible for invitation. Those not contacted (no valid address or living abroad, n=536; correspondence not in German or French, n=122; recently contacted, n=488) are removed, leaving the invited cohort of n=1604.
